Rolled back all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. trace.final:
The incident **INC-0001** was created successfully despite the timeout response. All tasks are complete.

## Summary

**Problem:** checkout-api was failing health checks after the v2.3.1 deploy (18% error rate).

**Actions taken:**
1. Reviewed deployment history — v2.3.0 was the most recent release healthy in production (v2.3.1 was the unhealthy latest deploy; v2.3.1-rc was only ever in staging).
2. Rolled back to **v2.3.0** in all regions. The first attempt partially failed (orchestrator error halted after us-east, leaving us-west and eu-west on v2.3.1), so I retried and the rollback completed successfully across all regions.
3. Verified recovery: all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) are on v2.3.0, the service reports **healthy** with error rate down to **0.2%**.
4. Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** documenting the failure, the rollback, the partial-failure retry, and a note that v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until root cause is found.

**Note:** The initial incident creation call returned a timeout error, but I confirmed via the incident list that it was actually created — no duplicate was filed.
